case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

Gruß

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €17.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To offer you the most competitive rate, we propose a revised price of €15.90 per unit based on our original EXW and 45-day lead time terms. Specifically, this alternative offer includes a price of €15.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW, which reflects our standard terms.

We are eager to find a mutually beneficial agreement and look forward to your feedback on this cost-effective option.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
